content:
Jess (Support): customer reports promo code not applying when they try to sign up for free trial. says flow forces card-on-file and 3DS challenge times out, UI shows \"authorization required\" and trial credit never granted. they sent screenshots + request-id: req_0a1b2c3d

acme-onboard (Customer): repro steps: 1) click signup, 2) enter card, 3) hits 3DS challenge, 4) after ~30s page shows error. using mobile Safari on iOS 16.6. promo code: ACME-TRY. tried twice.

Jess (Support): server logs show our payments service returned 502 to the frontend during tokenization: 
```
payments.tokenize() -> 502 gateway_timeout
stripe request id: r_9f8e7d6c
error: issuer_challenge_timeout
```

Alex (Payments Eng): thanks — can you paste the full payload from the client when they submit card? and the raw webhook events from Stripe (if available). also which region/PM config? is this on Dedicated EU or Hosted?

Jess (Support): hosted EU. attaching minimal client payload from customer: 
```
{\n  "card[number]": "4000000000003220",\n  "card[exp_month]": "12",\n  "card[exp_year]": "2026",\n  "promo": "ACME-TRY",\n  "return_url": "https://app.acme.example/onboard/return"\n}
```
(note: they used a real card masked in screenshot, shared last4)

StripeBot: webhook: payment_method.attached failed for customer cus_H7x... status=requires_action issuer_action=challenge timed_out

Alex (Payments Eng): looks like issuer sent a challenge but we got a timeout from the 3rd-party iframe (issuer) -> issuer_challenge_timeout. common on certain mobile browsers where SCA iframe blocks or background tab. two short-term options: 1) increase tokenization timeout on our side (not ideal, just masks issue), 2) switch to async payment method attach: create SetupIntent without confirming client-side redirect, then finish on server after customer completes challenge via return_url.

Maya (Oncall): is this impacting other customers? need to know to decide if we escalate to Stripe.

Jess (Support): only reported by acme so far; search across last 24h shows 6 similar issuer_challenge_timeout events in EU region.

Riley (Billing): for immediate workaround we can manually grant the trial credit and set a flag to not require card for this account, but need approval for risk review. acme is an SMB evaluation; risk low.

acme-onboard (Customer): happy with manual grant if you can do it. we just need to try the platform.

Alex (Payments Eng): repro locally with mobile Safari + 3G throttling using stripe test card for 3DS: `4000000000003220` should trigger a redirect challenge. I can try toggling our iframe timeout and test async SetupIntent flow.

Alex (Payments Eng): quick note — code we saw in their frontend is calling `createToken` then waiting for iframe confirm. recommend switching to `stripe.confirmCardSetup` with `return_url` flow to avoid blocking. example: 
```
const setupIntent = await fetch('/create-setup-intent');
await stripe.confirmCardSetup(setupIntent.client_secret, {payment_method: {card}});
```

Jess (Support): action items: Alex to attempt async flow and test on iOS Safari; Riley to authorize manual trial grant for acme; Maya to monitor for more issuer_challenge_timeout spikes and open Stripe support ticket if >10 in 24h.

Riley (Billing): approved manual credit of 14 days. giving to Jess to apply and mark account flag `skip_card_required=true` for this trial.

Jess (Support): applied manual 14-day trial credit to acct acct_0042, set `skip_card_required=true`. told customer to retry signup flow — they confirmed success.

acme-onboard (Customer): confirmed, signup completed and promo accepted after support applied credit. thanks! :tada:

Alex (Payments Eng): follow-ups: 1) add telemetry to correlate `issuer_challenge_timeout` with `user_agent` and `network_type`, 2) document async SetupIntent fallback in onboarding guide, 3) consider bumping iframe timeout in EU region to 45s while we investigate.

Maya (Oncall): opening monitoring alert rule: when issuer_challenge_timeout > 8 in 30m in any region -> page and assign to payments oncall.

Jess (Support): closing this thread once Alex posts repro results and we have Stripe ticket if we hit threshold.
